extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset of 13.7k Arabic book pages paired with their Markdown representations, created using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset used for training, arabic-img2md, contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website; Arabic book pages paired with Markdown representations; PDFs converted from the scraped HTML.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Known limitations include hallucination in arabic-small-nougat, repetition in larger models, scalability challenges due to significant computational resources, limited cross-script generalization, and difficulty with complex layouts; the paper also notes that repetition remains an area for improvement and that documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work aims to contribute to document parsing and promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic, and the open-sourcing of arabic-books is presented as a valuable resource for future Arabic NLP and OCR research.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The arabic-img2md synthetic dataset is designed to improve Arabic OCR performance, and the open-sourced arabic-books dataset is intended as a resource for future research in Arabic NLP and OCR; the models are designed to extract structured text from Arabic book pages into Markdown format.
